title: My roommate was secretly selling my clothes

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: My roommate was selling my clothes while I was at work.
41 of my clothes disappeared. My roommate made $900.
I found my own jacket on my roommate's profile.

hookVariants.visual: Tiff's closet, half empty, hangers swinging; a figure ducks out the door. Text hook: SHE SOLD MY CLOSET.

Same line and text hook; frame 0 is Tiff's face mid-reaction (eyes wide), then a whip to the key prop.

beats.text: My roommate was selling my clothes while I was at *work*.
beats.visual: Tiff's closet, half empty, hangers swinging; a figure ducks out the door. Text hook: SHE SOLD MY CLOSET.

beats.text: I thought I was just losing things: a top, a belt, my *jeans*.
beats.visual: Tiff searching drawers, items blink out of a checklist one by one.

beats.text: Then I saw my own jacket on someone else's *profile*.
beats.visual: Phone: a listing of Tiff's olive jacket, photographed on Tiff's bed.

beats.text: Listed by *Brooke*. Photographed on my bed.

beats.visual: Grid of listings fills the screen, counter ticks to 41.

beats.text: I didn't scream. I just bought my jacket *back*. From her.
beats.visual: Tiff calmly clicks BUY on Brooke's listing.

beats.text: Shipped to our address. She opened the box right in *front* of me.
beats.visual: Kitchen: Brooke opens a parcel, Tiff leaning on the counter.

beats.text: We just stared. Her face went *white*.
Now my stuff's on pileGo, under *my* name.
beats.visual: Tiff's room: she snaps her clothes, listings fly to app tiles with her name.

beats.text: When it sells, it comes down everywhere, so nobody sells it *twice*.
beats.visual: One SOLD card; the same item vanishes from five other apps.

beats.text: Brooke moved out Friday. She left her *mattress*. It's listed.
beats.visual: Empty room, a lone mattress with a SOLD sticker.
